recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit for core. If the current SDC IG still limits observation pre-population or extraction matching to Questionnaire.item.code, handle that as SDC IG follow-up rather than adding redundant core Questionnaire prose without a new work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-23765 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Questionnaire request to let Questionnaire.item.definition reference ObservationDefinition and to update population/extraction guidance so an ObservationDefinition definition can be used as an alternative to item.code when selecting Observations to populate from or extract to.
initial_application: Core source was already changed by 6eb67586f8, which added ObservationDefinition to the Questionnaire.item.definition comment, and by 256b419e69, which added ObservationDefinition to the formal element definition. The Jira comment records Core Git: Questionnaire-fixes 6eb67586f8 and notes that SDC changes were still needed outside the core application.
additional_context: Questionnaire and ObservationDefinition are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. The originating Zulip thread supports the request. SDC minutes show the remaining post-core concern was whether ObservationDefinition should expose ElementDefinition/Profile-style constraints; related issues FHIR-31747 and FHIR-31748 were resolved no-change/retracted, so no later decision requires more core Questionnaire source changes.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current core element definition and comment already state that Questionnaire.item.definition may refer to an ObservationDefinition, and SDC-specific population/extraction guidance is outside this FHIR-core checkout.

related_jiras.note: OO considered adding ElementDefinition/StructureDefinition-style value constraints to ObservationDefinition for this Questionnaire use case and resolved no-change.
A related FHIR-I follow-up was retracted because the submitter determined profile links already covered it.
